note: Supplemental evidence only; original source dictionary remains unchanged. Definitions carry original editorial context/status. Enumeration membership does not establish presentation meaning.

1cPrereqs.definition: The element <1cPrereqs> describes required knowledge, credits and experience a student must have to take a course.
1cPrereqs.title: Prerequisites

accessDoorOrPanel.definition: The element <accessDoorOrPanel> contains information about doors or panels to be opened for getting access to the equipment.
accessDoorOrPanel.title: Access door or panel

accessFrom.definition: This element allows specifying the zone(s) and/or access point(s) from which the functional item can be reached .
accessFrom.title: Accesses to the functional item

accessory.definition: The element <accessory> is contained in the list of accessories element <accessoryGroup>. The list of accessories is a child element of the list of the standard parts element <standardPartGroup>.
accessory.title: Accessory

accessoryGroup.definition: The list of acessories <accessoryGroup> contains the accessories.
accessoryGroup.title: List of accessories

accessPointAlt.definition: This element contains the properties of the access point that depend on the Product configuration. Thus this element contains applicability.
accessPointAlt.title: Alternate access points

accessPointIdent.definition: Contrary to the attribute id, this element identifies semantically the access point with regard to its attributes.
accessPointIdent.title: Access point identifier

accessPointRef.definition: The element <accessPointRef> is used to store the access point’s identification where an item is located. It is used in accordance with the rules in Chap 3.4.
accessPointRef.title: Access point

accessPointRefGroup.definition: The element <accessPointRef> is used to store the access point’s identification where an item is located. It is used in accordance with the rules in Chap 3.4.
accessPointRefGroup.title: References to other access points

accessPointRepository.definition: This element is used to provide a list of access points and their associated properties.
accessPointRepository.title: Access point repository

accessPointSpec.definition: This element represents one access point. It contains its associated properties.
accessPointSpec.title: Access point specification

accessPointType.definition: This element is used to specify, through its attribute, whether the access point is a panel, a door, an electrical panel or any other type of access point.
accessPointType.title: Access point type

accessTo.definition: This element allows listing items that can be reached from the access point. Those items can be functional items or other items.
accessTo.title: Items reachable from the access point

acronym.definition: The element <acronymTerm> contains the acronym itself and the definition of the acronym when that acronym is first used.
acronym.title: Acronym

acronymDefinition.definition: The element <acronymDefinition> contains the definition of the acronym when that acronym is first used.
acronymDefinition.title: Acronym definition

acronymTerm.definition: The element <acronymTerm> contains the acronym itself and a reference to its definition.
acronymTerm.title: Acronym term

action.definition: The element <action> contains an action in the isolation procedure.
action.title: Action

additionalModification.definition: The element <additionalModification> contains an indication that a modification is additionally covered.
additionalModification.title: Additional modification

address.definition: The postal address from where the comment/response is sent.
address.title: Address

altIdent.definition: The alternative identification element <altIdent> is used for additional identification of a harness. An alternative identification can contain a manufacturer part number and the related manufacturer code.
altIdent.title: Alternative identification

altIdentGroup.definition: The list of alternative identifications element <altIdentGroup> is used as a container for the subordinate alternative identification elements.
altIdentGroup.title: Alternative identifications

altPart.definition: This element provides one or several alternate part(s), ie parts that can be used on condition that a modification has been performed. The description of the modification can be provided.
altPart.title: Alternate parts

altPartDescr.definition: This element is used to describe the modification to be performed on one alternate part.
altPartDescr.title: Alternate part modification

amperage.definition: The element <amperage> contains the amperage information of the wire material.
amperage.title: Amperage

answer.definition: This element can be used to insert comments on the data module requirement list entry.
answer.title: Data module requirement answer

applic.definition: The element <applic> is populated by the technical author or generated by the production system during initial authoring and updating activity of the data module.
applic.title: Applicability model

applicabilitySegment.definition: The element <applicabilitySegment> is used to identify an S2000M Applicability Segment (CCS).
applicabilitySegment.title: CCS data

applicCrossRefTableRef.definition: The element <applicCrossRefTableRef> contains a pointer to the Applicability Cross-reference Table (ACT) data module that applies to the data module/ publication module.
applicCrossRefTableRef.title: Applicability cross-reference table reference

assert.definition: The element <assert> provides for a single test for the computable branch of the applicability annotation. The assert annotation specifies the product attribute or condition to test and a set of values and/or ranges to test against. The result of evaluating an assert annotation will be a Boolean value of 'true' or 'false'.
assert.title: Single applicability test - assert

assertion.definition: The element <assertion> assigns a value to a variable.
assertion.title: Assertion

assign.definition: The element <assign> associates a value with a product attribute or condition. It contains the following attributes:
assign.title: Assign

assocWarningMalfunction.definition: The associated fault (warning or malfunction) which is part of the current correlated fault.
assocWarningMalfunction.title: Associated warning or malfunction

assy.definition: The equipment assembly information element <assy> contains subordinate assembly information for the equipment in coded form and references to detailed assembly instructions.
assy.title: Assembly information

assyInstruction.definition: The element <assyInstruction> is used as a container for the subordinate accessory assembly information. Refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.9.5.
assyInstruction.title: Assembly instructions

attachmentRef.definition: The file name consists of the prefix "COM", the comment identification code, a sequential number for the attachment in this comment (MM) and the file type extension (eg .PDF, .ZIP, .XLS).
attachmentRef.title: Reference to an attachment

attachStoreShipPart.definition: The element <attachStoreShipPart> is used to indicate if an item is an attaching, storage or shipping part using the attribute
attachStoreShipPart.title: Attaching storage or shipping part

attentionListItemPara.definition: The element <attentionListItemPara> contains the list items paragraphs when one or more list item paragraphs are needed.
attentionListItemPara.title: Attention list item para

attentionRandomList.definition: The element <attentionRandomList> contains the list items.
attentionRandomList.title: Attention random list

attentionRandomListItem.definition: The element <attentionRandomListItem> contains one list item for attention random lists.
attentionRandomListItem.title: Attention random list item

attentionSequentialList.definition: The element <attentionSequentialList> contains an attention sequential (ordered) list in a note. This element mirrors the element <sequentialList> with the exception that the following content is not available:
attentionSequentialList.title: Attention sequential list

attentionSequentialListItem.definition: The element <attentionSequentialListItem> contains list items and can consist of one or more paragraphs.
attentionSequentialListItem.title: Attention sequential list item

attenuation.definition: The element <attenuation> contains the attenuation information of wire material.
attenuation.title: Attenuation

authorityExceptions.definition: The element <authorityExceptions> contains deviations of the data module content from the standard given in the authority block for configurations.
authorityExceptions.title: Authority exceptions

authorityInfo.definition: The element <authorityInfo> contains the authority that owns the source data from which the data module is written. The codes to be used in this element are to be determined by the project.
authorityInfo.title: Authority information

authorityInfoAndTp.definition: The element <authorityInfoAndTp> contains both the authority block information and the technical publications baseline when it is appropriate to use both.
authorityInfoAndTp.title: Authority block and technical publications information

authorityNotes.definition: The element <authorityNotes> contains additional information that can be necessary to explain preceding entries. Whenever a data module is only applicable to one or a range of serial numbers, this is stated here. It is recommended that, where applicable, the titles of documents be given under authority exceptions. The notes are also be used for recording deficiency reports, special technical orders, service bulletins, explanations of excluded and additional modifications, and similar documents.
authorityNotes.title: Authority notes

basicCorrelatedFaults.definition: The element <basicCorrelatedFaults> contains the list of basic faults (messages and/or warnings) that have been correlated.
basicCorrelatedFaults.title: Messages and warnings

behavior.definition: The element <behavior> specifies how the link operates, when a reference is supposed to be realized as a link.
behavior.title: Link behavior information

bitMessage.definition: The basic fault (computerized message or warning/malfunction) which is part of the current correlated fault.
bitMessage.title: Computerized message from built-in test equipment

blockGroupingValue.definition: The element <blockGroupingValue> contains the block information of terminal modules. Refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.9.2.
blockGroupingValue.title: Block grouping information

boundary.definition: This element describes a boundary. A boundary can be expressed textually or with specific measures (rib, frame...)
boundary.title: A boundary

boundaryFrom.definition: These elements are used to define the boundaries of a zone, respectively the start and the end boundaries.
boundaryFrom.title: Zone boundaries

boundaryTo.definition: These elements are used to define the boundaries of a zone, respectively the start and the end boundaries.
boundaryTo.title: Zone boundaries

brex.definition: The element <brex> contains all business rules specified by a BREX data module.
brex.title: Exchange business rules

brexDmRef.definition: The element <brexDmRef> contains a pointer to the business rules data module (BREX data module) that applies to the data module. For a detailed description of the BREX module and related aspects, refer to Chap 4.10.
brexDmRef.title: Business rules reference

building.definition: The element <building> contains the building number where the business is located.
building.title: Building identifier

businessUnit.definition: The element <businessUnit> contains information about the business, including name, address, and contacts.
businessUnit.title: Business unit

businessUnitAddress.definition: The element <businessUnitAddress> contains the information required to contact the business unit.
businessUnitAddress.title: Business unit address

businessUnitName.definition: The element <businessUnitName> contains a string identifying the name of the business unit.
businessUnitName.title: Business unit name

buyerFurnishedEquipFlag.definition: This element is used as a flag to specify whether the customer furnishes the part or not. As this value depends on the customer, the attribute applicRefId and the referenced element <applic>, both must be populated in accordance with Chap 3.9.5.3.
buyerFurnishedEquipFlag.title: Buyer furnished equipment flag

calibrationMarker.definition: The element <calibrationMarker> is used to identify items that require calibration. This element should be set to "1" if an item requires calibration.
calibrationMarker.title: Calibration marker

caption.definition: This element <caption> represents a single illuminated warning light, push button, annunciator, or display caption. It can be used inline within text content elements such as <para>, or grouped within the element <captionGroup> structure as given in Para 2.
caption.title: Captions

captionBody.definition: The element <captionBody> is equivalent to a CALS table element <tbody>. Refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.1.6.
captionBody.title: Caption body

captionEntry.definition: The element <captionEntry> represents the table cells that contain the captions or caption text; it is equivalent to a CALS table element <entry>. Refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.1.6.
captionEntry.title: Caption entry

captionGroup.definition: The element <captionGroup> is equivalent to a CALS table element <table>. It is used to represent blocks of illuminated warning lights, push buttons, annunciators, or display captions.
captionGroup.title: Caption group

captionLine.definition: This element represents a single line of text, so its text content should not wrap to second or subsequent lines.
captionLine.title: Caption line

captionRow.definition: The element <captionRow> represents a caption table row and is equivalent to a CALS table element <row>. Refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.1.6.
captionRow.title: Caption row

captionText.definition: The element <captionText> allows text to be added to a <captionGroup>.
captionText.title: Caption text

case.definition: The element <case> is used to identify a case as part of a list of possible cases.
case.title: Case statement

caseCond.definition: The element <caseCond> is used to identify a condition as part of an "if" statement.
caseCond.title: Condition statement

catalogSeqNumber.definition: The mandatory repeatable element <catalogSeqNumber> is used to store the catalogue sequence number (CSN) and all related parts information.
catalogSeqNumber.title: Catalogue sequence number

catalogSeqNumberRef.definition: The element <catalogSeqNumberRef> provides a reference to the IPD CSN that corresponds to the equipment. Refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.7.
catalogSeqNumberRef.title: Catalog sequence number reference

categoryOneContainerLocation.definition: The element <categoryOneContainerLocation> is used to record the location at which the data record of an item’s category 1 container is held.
categoryOneContainerLocation.title: Category 1 container location

caution.definition: The element <caution> contains hazard information that can cause damage to the Product.
caution.title: Cautions

challenge.definition: The element <challenge> is used to identify a crew/operator challenge and response.
challenge.title: Challenge

challengeAndResponse.definition: The element <challengeAndResponse> is used to identify a crew/operator challenge and response.
challengeAndResponse.title: Crew/operator challenge and response

changeAuthorityNumber.definition: The element <changeAuthorityNumber> is used to store the change authority number (CAN).
changeAuthorityNumber.title: Change authority number

changeInline.definition: The element <changeInline> must be used for changed data modules when changing parts of text within certain elements (eg paragraphs, titles etc) that contain the <changeInline> element.
changeInline.title: General rules for marking text as changed

checkList.definition: The element <checkList> is used to contain the checklist information. It has an attribute checkListCategory which can be set to the checklist type. Checklist type is an organization or project specific business rule decision and is populated as described in Chap 3.9.6.1. For each category identified, an organization or project can establish business rules for which elements to use and/or how to markup checklists for each category type.
checkList.title: Checklist and maintenance planning information

checkListInfo.definition: Checklist information includes a variety of optional elements and repeatable elements allowing for markup in a variety of ways. The check list information is intended to group items together that will create the checklist data. This element includes the following elements.
checkListInfo.title: Check list information

checkListIntervals.definition: The element <checkListIntervals> contains an optional and repeatable element <checkListInterval>. This element is used to capture the various maintenance intervals used in an inspection or checklist. These intervals can be used to capture information for use with maintenance interval columns. For example, a table might have a column for 500 hours and a column for 1000 hours. These columns would then have a check mark in the appropriate task row to indicate when the maintenance should be performed.
checkListIntervals.title: Check list intervals

checkListItem.definition: The repeatable element <checkListItem> contains a number of elements used to capture items specific for an inspection or maintenance check. The element <checkListItem> presents an optional item number, followed by an optional threshold. It continues with a choice of equipment or nomenclature and a choice of references and check list procedures. The next two items are an optional zone and optional remarks. These items are detailed in paragraphs that follow.
checkListItem.title: Check list item

checkListProcedure.definition: The element <checkListProcedure> is used to contain a brief description of each check to be performed as well as any information required to accomplish a check or service. This element contains either paragraph text or a series of check list steps.
checkListProcedure.title: Check list procedure

circuitBreakerAlt.definition: This element contains the properties of the circuit breaker that depend on the Product configuration. Thus this element contains applicability.
circuitBreakerAlt.title: Alternate circuit breaker

circuitBreakerClass.definition: This element indicates whether the circuit breaker is electronic or electro-mechanic.
circuitBreakerClass.title: Circuit breaker class

circuitBreakerDescr.definition: The element <circuitBreakerDescr> contains the information on individual circuit breakers.
circuitBreakerDescr.title: Circuit breaker description

circuitBreakerDescrGroup.definition: The element <circuitBreakerDescrGroup> contains the circuit breaker lists information.
circuitBreakerDescrGroup.title: Circuit breaker description group

circuitBreakerDescrSubGroup.definition: The element <circuitBreakerDescrSubGroup> contains one or more sub circuit breaker lists.
circuitBreakerDescrSubGroup.title: Circuit breaker description subgroup

circuitBreakerIdent.definition: Contrary to the attribute id, this element identifies semantically the functional item as a result of its attributes.
circuitBreakerIdent.title: Circuit breaker identifier

circuitBreakerLocation.definition: The element <circuitBreakerLocation> contains the textual description of the circuit breaker location in the circuit breaker panel.
circuitBreakerLocation.title: Circuit breaker location

circuitBreakerRef.definition: The element <circuitBreakerRef> contains the details about the circuit breaker, eg number, circuit breaker action and circuit breaker type.
circuitBreakerRef.title: Circuit breaker reference

circuitBreakerRepository.definition: This element is used to provide a list of circuit breakers and their associated properties.
circuitBreakerRepository.title: Circuit Breaker Repository

circuitBreakerSpec.definition: This element represents one circuit breaker. It contains its associated properties.
circuitBreakerSpec.title: Circuit breaker specification

circuitIdent.definition:
Projects with electrical wiring often consist of several systems or circuits. If the
allocation of a wire to a system must be reflected in the wire identification, the circuit code must
be populated with the identifier for this system/circuit.
circuitIdent.title: Circuit code

city.definition: The element <city> contains the name of the city where the business is located.
city.title: City

clippingPoint.definition: The clipping points of a wire that fasten it to the structure of an aircraft, an equipment etc, are listed in the <clippingPoint> elements. If used, every clipping point must be populated in exactly one of the <clippingPoint> elements, ie the clipping point identification contains one clipping point that fastens the wire to the structure.
clippingPoint.title: Clipping point information

closeRqmts.definition: The element <closeRqmts> contains any actions that are required after the Procedure is complete.
closeRqmts.title: Requirements after job completion

coaxialCableFlag.definition: The coax information element <coaxialCableFlag> identifies coaxial contacts.
coaxialCableFlag.title: Coaxial information

colspec.definition: The element <colspec> (column specification) is used in the table group (<tgroup>, refer to Para 2.5.1) and can be overridden by <colspec> elements in the table header (<thead>, refer to Para 2.5.2), table footer (<tfoot>, refer to Para 2.5.3) and the table body (<tbody>, refer to Para 2.5.4). When used in the table header, table footer and table body, the values specified override those that can be present on the table group and these values are in turn overridden by the settings of the same attributes on individual rows and entries
colspec.title: Column specification

comment.definition: The comment data module consists of two main sections of information: the identification and status section and the content section.
comment.title: Comment

commentAddress.definition: The comment address consists of two blocks of information items used to address the comment object, the comment identification and the supplementary comment address items.
commentAddress.title: Comment address

commentAddressItems.definition: Supports the identification of a comment object.
commentAddressItems.title: Comment address items

commentCode.definition: The comment code comprises up to 29 alphanumeric characters. It is built up as shown in Table 2. The minimum length is 17 characters.
commentCode.title: Comment code

commentContent.definition: The content section contains the comment and/or the response to a comment.
commentContent.title: Content section

commentIdent.definition: The comment identification establishes the unique identity of a comment object.
commentIdent.title: Comment identification

commentOriginator.definition: Describes the originator of the comment. Details of the originator (name, phone number, etc.) must be given.
commentOriginator.title: Originator

commentPriority.definition: This element contains the priority of the comment.
commentPriority.title: Comment priority

commentRefs.definition: This element contains the reference to the information the comment is referring to. References are allowed to publication modules (including the entire publication set via list of applicable publications), data modules, data module lists or data dispatch notes. For each comment raised, there must be at least one reference. This element must not be used for responses to the comment (use subelement <noReferences>).
commentRefs.title: Comment references

commentResponse.definition: This element indicates the type of response to the comment.
commentResponse.title: Comment response

commentStatus.definition: Describes the status of the comment form.
commentStatus.title: Comment status

commonInfo.definition: The element <commonInfo> contains descriptive information that applies to an entire data module.
commonInfo.title: Common information

commonInfoDescrPara.definition: The element <commonInfoDescrPara> is used to contain text information.
commonInfoDescrPara.title: Descriptive Paragraph Definition

componentAssy.definition: The element <componentAssy> is used to identify the item name or nomenclature (a basic name and a noun word or phrase modifier, eg transformer) and must be marked up using the element <name>. Parts that are not subject to maintenance must not be listed.
componentAssy.title: Component assembly

componentAssyGroup.definition: The element <componentAssyGroup> is used when there is a requirement to subdivide the list into subassemblies.
componentAssyGroup.title: Component Assembly Group

condCrossRefTableRef.definition: The element <condCrossRefTableRef> provides a reference to the CCT data module for this project.
condCrossRefTableRef.title: CCT reference

condIncorporation.definition: The element <condIncorporation> represents a technical condition that has or is planned to be incorporated into the technical data. It can reference a declared condition (element <cond>) and consists of a list of documents affected by the technical condition.
condIncorporation.title: Condition incorporation

condList.definition: The element <condList> contains a list of specific conditions which have an effect on the applicability of technical data.
condList.title: Conditions list

condType.definition: The element <condType> is used to define a single condition type of the Product.
condType.title: Condition type

condTypeList.definition: The element <condTypeList> contains a list of common types of conditions which will be used as a basis for defining specific conditions.
condTypeList.title: Condition types list

conduit.definition: The element <conduit> is contained in the list of conduits element <conduitGroup>. The list of conduits is a child element of the list of the standard parts element <standardPartGroup>.
conduit.title: Element <conduit>

connectionListClass.definition: The connection list class element <connectionListClass> describes special groups of equipment, eg switches, connectors etc, in coded form.
connectionListClass.title: Connection list class

connector.definition: The element <connector> is contained in the connector list element <connectorGroup>. The list of connectors is a child element of the list of standard parts element <standardPartGroup>.
connector.title: Element <connector> and child elements

connectorAccessories.definition: The element <connectorAccessories> contains the part numbers of accessories for the connector.
connectorAccessories.title: List of accessories

contact.definition: This element describes the contact identification by its attributes. Normally, wires are connected to contacts with designation identification. If not, the contact designation identification attribute contactIdent has no value for those contacts where at least one of the other attributes is used. If none of the attributes is used, the element <contact> must not be used at all.
contact.title: Contact identification

contactCount.definition: The element <contactCount> contains the number of contacts of the connector.
contactCount.title: Contact count

contactDescr.definition: The element <contactDescr> contains a list of contact descriptions.
contactDescr.title: Contact description

contactDescrGroup.definition: The element <contactDescrGroup> contains a list of contact descriptions.
contactDescrGroup.title: List of contact descriptions

contactDiameter.definition: This element describes the diameter of a contact.
contactDiameter.title: Contact diameter

contactInfo.definition: The contact information element contains child elements that identify the contact to which the wire end is connected.
contactInfo.title: Contact information

contactOrderValue.definition: The contact order element <contactOrderValue> is used to order the wire ends, connected to equipment with internal logic, in addition to the termination module, block and shunt grouping elements.
contactOrderValue.title: Contact order information

contactPerson.definition: The element <contactPerson> is repeatable and contains all information related to individual contacts for a business unit.
contactPerson.title: Contact persons

contactPersonAddress.definition: The element <contactPersonAddress> contains the information required to identify the contact person.
contactPersonAddress.title: Contact person address

contactSize.definition: The element <contactSize> contains size information about a distribution part, normally for a contact.
contactSize.title: Contact size

container.definition: This element is used to provide the list of alternate data modules, that the "container" contains.
container.title: Container

content.definition: The element <content> contains the content section of the data module/ publication module.
content.title: Content section

contextAndIsolationInfo.definition: The element <contextAndIsolationInfo> contains the description of the context in which the fault is observed and information needed to isolate the faulty item.
contextAndIsolationInfo.title: Context and isolation information

contextRules.definition: The element <contextRules> can be repeated to give the rules for different contexts within a project. Business rules specified by a BREX data module, and concerned with how the information structures (ie schemas) can be used, must define the context to which they are related. The context can be the entire project or it can be information in accordance with one of the Schemas that are applied within the project. Rules given for a specific context override rules specified for all contexts. If rules are defined for an object more than once, the first occurrence of rules for that object takes precedence.
contextRules.title: Context related rules

controlIndicatorDescr.definition: The element <controlIndicatorDescr> is used to store information specific to a control or indicator.
controlIndicatorDescr.title: Control or indicator description

controlIndicatorFunction.definition: The element <controlIndicatorFunction> is used to store one or more brief descriptions of the control or indicator function.
controlIndicatorFunction.title: Control or indicator function

controlIndicatorGroup.definition: The element <controlIndicatorGroup> (one or more) is used to contain unique identification of controls and indicators, each grouped by equipment, assembly, or control panel.
controlIndicatorGroup.title: Control or indicator group

controlIndicatorKey.definition: The element <controlIndicatorKey> contains the illustration or index key of the control or indicator.
controlIndicatorKey.title: Control or indicator key

controlIndicatorName.definition: The element <controlIndicatorName> contains the designation of the control or indicator.
controlIndicatorName.title: Control or indicator designation

controlIndicatorRef.definition: The element <controlIndicatorRef> contains the number and name of the controls or indicators and the reference to the control and indicator repository data module.
controlIndicatorRef.title: Controls and indicators

controlIndicatorRepository.definition: The element <controlIndicatorRepository> is used to capture and represent control and indicator information.
controlIndicatorRepository.title: Controls and indicators repository

controlIndicatorSpec.definition: The element <controlIndicatorSpec> contains control and indicator information including illustration or index key, designation, and description. This element is the target when a control or indicator is referenced from another data module (eg procedural data module), using the element <controlIndicatorRef>. Refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.1.10.
controlIndicatorSpec.title: Control and indicator information

copyright.definition: The element <copyright> contains the copyright statement.
copyright.title: Copyright

copyrightPara.definition: The element <copyrightPara> contains the copyright statement itself or provides a cross-reference to another data module, which contains the statement.
copyrightPara.title: Copyright paragraph

correlatedFault.definition: The element <correlatedFault> contains the information on correlated faults.
correlatedFault.title: Correlated faults

country.definition: The element <country> contains the International Standards Organisation (ISO) country code where the business is located.
country.title: Country Code

crew.definition: The mandatory element <crew> is the container for all crew/operator content (excluding references).
crew.title: Crew

crewDrill.definition: The element <crewDrill> is used to contain a crew/operator drill.
crewDrill.title: Drill

crewDrillStep.definition: The element <crewDrillStep> is used to identify a step in a crew/operator data module.
crewDrillStep.title: Crew drill step

crewMember.definition: The empty, conditionally mandatory element <crewMember> is used to identify a crew/operator member.
crewMember.title: Crew member

crewMemberGroup.definition: The element <crewMemberGroup> is used to identify the crew/operator responsible for carrying out an action.
crewMemberGroup.title: Crew

crewProcedureName.definition: The element <crewProcedureName> is used to identify a crew/operator procedure.
crewProcedureName.title: Crew/operator procedure

crewRefCard.definition: The optional element <crewRefCard> is used to contain flight reference card information or its equivalent for land/sea Products.
crewRefCard.title: Reference card

dataConds.definition: The element <dataConds> contains any information on any special conditions that can apply to the data module. For example the security classification of a data module may have to change when aggregated with other data modules with similar conditions.
dataConds.title: Data conditions

dataDestruction.definition: The element <dataDestruction> contains any destruction instructions that are specific to the data module.
dataDestruction.title: Data destruction

dataDisclosure.definition: The element <dataDisclosure> contains any special instructions with regard to the dissemination of the data module.
dataDisclosure.title: Data disclosure

dataDistribution.definition: The element <dataDistribution> contains the instructions for distribution of a data module.
dataDistribution.title: Data distribution

dataHandling.definition: The element <dataHandling> contains any handling instructions, including storage, that are specific to the data module.
dataHandling.title: Data handling

dataRestrictions.definition: The element <dataRestrictions> contains the instructions and information, applicable to the data module, that relate to the use, storage and handling. This element can contain applicability information.
dataRestrictions.title: Data restrictions

ddnCode.definition: This element contains a references to a dispatch note to which the comment/response relates.
ddnCode.title: Dispatch note identification code

ddnRef.definition: This element contains a reference to a dispatch note to which the comment/response relates.
ddnRef.title: Dispatch note reference

ddnRefAddressItems.definition: This element contains a references to a dispatch note to which the comment/response relates.
ddnRefAddressItems.title: Supplementary addressing information pertinent to a dispatch note

ddnRefGroup.definition: This element contains one or several references to dispatch notes to which the comment/response relates.
ddnRefGroup.title: Dispatch note reference group

ddnRefIdent.definition: This element contains the unique identity of a referred dispatch note.
ddnRefIdent.title: Dispatch note reference identity

default.definition: The user entry can have a default value that pre-populates the user entry field with the value.
default.title: Default user entry

definitionList.definition: The element <definitionList> contains a list of terms and definitions. It can contain applicability information, a title and a definition list header. The body of the definition list comprises one or more definition list items, each containing a term and its definition.
definitionList.title: Definition list

definitionListHeader.definition: The element <definitionListHeader> contains the column header of the definition list. It can contain the term title and the definition title.
definitionListHeader.title: Definition list headers

definitionListItem.definition: The element <definitionListItem> contains the body of the definition list.
definitionListItem.title: Definition list item

definitionTitle.definition: The element <definitionTitle> contains the column title for the definition.

description.definition: The element <description> is used to contain the descriptive information. Descriptive paragraphs can be broken down into subparagraphs, which can be broken down further into sub-subparagraphs and so on. The depth of this breakdown is unlimited, however, it is recommended to not exceed five levels of depth. It is further recommended that additional levels only be used in a conversion effort, where existing data is authored to such a depth and restructuring of data is not feasible. In these cases, the subparagraph breakdown must never exceed eight levels of depth. The project or the organization must decide on the depth of breakdown.
description.title: Description

descrMass.title: Mass information description

descrOuterDiameter.title: Outer diameter description

reqTechInfoGroup.definition: The element <reqTechInfoGroup> contains references to any technical documents that are required, in addition to the actual data module, for the maintainer to complete the procedure. The list is not a reference list but can be equated to a special tool that needs to be selected. For example, required technical info can be engineering drawings not included in the data module that the maintainer needs to check out of a drawing library in order to complete the maintenance tasks.
reqTechInfoGroup.title: Required technical information

resistance.definition: The element <resistance> contains the direct current (DC) resistance information of wire material.
resistance.title: Resistance

response.definition: The element <response> is the expected response to the challenge.
response.title: Response

responsiblePartnerCompany.definition: The element <responsiblePartnerCompany> contains the company or organization responsible content.
responsiblePartnerCompany.title: Responsible partner company

restriction.definition: The wire restriction information element <restriction> contains restrictions concerning a wire.
restriction.title: Wire restriction

restrictionInfo.definition: The element <restrictionInfo> contains any other information that is related to data restrictions, such as copyright information, policy references and other conditions.
restrictionInfo.title: Restriction information

restrictionInstructions.definition: The element <restrictionInstructions> contains the instructions that are to be followed when data restrictions apply.
restrictionInstructions.title: Restriction instructions

retrofit.definition: The element <retrofit> contains a reference to post delivery changes that are always performed in accordance with a retrofit order eg Pre– or Post–modification.
retrofit.title: Retrofit

room.definition: The element <room> contains the room number in the building where the business is located.
room.title: Room number

routing.definition: The element <routing> contains routing information of a wire via clipping points and special components, eg current transformers, panels or bungs, through which wires pass.
routing.title: Routing

row.definition: The element <row> (table row) represents a row in a table header (refer to Para 2.5.2), a table footer (refer to Para 2.5.3), or a table body (refer to Para 2.5.4). The table row contains at least one <entry> (refer to Para 2.5.8). The values specified for the attributes rowsep and valign override any values for these attributes given in a parent element. These values are also overridden by any settings applied to <entry> elements.
row.title: Table row

rqmtSource.definition: The element <rqmtSource> gives information to enable identification of the authority that is the source of the maintenance requirement.
rqmtSource.title: Requirement source

safetyCategory.definition: The element <safetyCategory> is used to specify, through its attribute, the safety category of the supply listed in the supply requirement alternative.
safetyCategory.title: Category

safetyRqmts.definition: If there are any safety requirements, then the element <safetyRqmts> must be used. This element can be populated with the attribute warningRefs or the attribute cautionRefs, or the element <warning>, the element <caution>, or the element <note>, as described at Chap 3.9.3.
safetyRqmts.title: Safety requirements

sampling.definition: This element <sampling> contains a description of a subset of the total number of Product instances on which the inspection must be performed. The sampling can be given as a percentage, a fraction or as a textual description. This element has only text content. This element must be omitted if the inspection must be performed on the full set of Products.
sampling.title: Sampling

scoEntry.definition: The SCO entry (one or more) is the central element for a SCORM content package and can be defined recursively. This allows SCORM content package structures in variable depth.
scoEntry.title: SCO Entry

scoEntryAddress.definition: The element <scoEntryAddress> is used to provide an address for each SCO entry within the SCORM content package. The SCO entry address information is given.
scoEntryAddress.title: SCO entry address

scoEntryCode.definition: Learning products produced according to this specification must be given a SCO entry code.
scoEntryCode.title: SCO entry code

scoEntryContent.definition: The SCO entry content section is contained within the element <scoEntryContent>.
scoEntryContent.title: SCO entry content

scoEntryTitle.definition: The title must give the meaning of the learning product and are defined by the project.
scoEntryTitle.title: SCO entry title

scoMedia.definition: The element <scoMedia> has mandatory attributes: type and code (label) of the media on which the SCO entry is delivered. Additional optional attributes are volume and location of the media. This element can be repeated.
scoMedia.title: SCO media

scormContentPackage.definition: The element <scormContentPackage> is the root of the schema. It contains two major element wrappers: the element <identAndStatusSection> describes training life cycle and configuration information; the element <content> contains pointers to training and maintenance information to support the aggregation of a learning product deliverable.
scormContentPackage.title: Purpose

scormContentPackageAddress.definition: The SCORM content package address is used to apply a code and a title to a SCORM content package.
scormContentPackageAddress.title: SCORM content package address

scormContentPackageAddressItems.definition: The SCORM content address items provide a title to the learning product deliverable.
scormContentPackageAddressItems.title: SCORM content package address items

scormContentPackageCode.definition: The SCORM content package code contains code that identifies the content packages produced according to this specification must be given a SCORM content package Code (SCORM module code).
scormContentPackageCode.title: SCORM content package code

descrSystemBreakdownCode.definition: The element <descrSystemBreakdownCode> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for system break down code element <systemBreakdownCode>. Refer to Para 2.1.
descrSystemBreakdownCode.title: System breakdown code description

descrTerminationModuleGroupingValue.definition: The element <descrTerminationModuleGroupingValue> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the termination module grouping information element <terminationModuleGroupingValue> under the contact description element <contactDescr>. Refer to Para 2.1.
descrTerminationModuleGroupingValue.title: Termination module grouping information description

descrThermoCoupleMinus.definition: The element <descrThermoCoupleMinus> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the thermo couple minus information element <thermoCoupleMinus>. Refer to Para 2.1.
descrThermoCoupleMinus.title: Thermo couple minus information description

descrThermoCouplePlus.definition: The element <descrThermoCouplePlus> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the thermo couple plus information element <thermoCouplePlus>. Refer to Para 2.1.
descrThermoCouplePlus.title: Thermo couple plus information description

descrTransverseLink.definition: The element <descrTransverseLink> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the contact identification element <contact> under the electrical equipment connection element <electricalEquipConnection> of the transverse link element <transverseLink>. Refer to Para 2.1.
descrTransverseLink.title: Transverse link information description

descrTriaxialCableFlag.definition: The element <descrTriaxialCableFlag> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the tri-axial information element <triaxialCableFlag>. Refer to Para 2.1.
descrTriaxialCableFlag.title: Tri-axial information description

descrTwist.definition: The element <descrTwist> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the twist element <twist>. Refer to Para 2.1.
descrTwist.title: Twist information description

descrVoltage.definition: The element <descrVoltage> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the voltage information element <voltage>. Refer to Para 2.1.
descrVoltage.title: Voltage information description

descrWallThickness.definition: The element <descrWallThickness> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the wall thickness element <wallThickness>. Refer to Para 2.1.
descrWallThickness.title: Wall thickness description

descrWire.definition: The element <descrWire> contains all relevant elements to describe the wire data elements of the project.
descrWire.title: Wire data/field descriptions

descrWireColor.definition: The element <descrWireColor> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the color element <wireColor>. Refer to Para 2.1.
descrWireColor.title: Color information description

descrWireConnectionCode.definition: The element <descrWireConnectionCode> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the wire connection code element <wireConnectionCode>. Refer to Para 2.1.
descrWireConnectionCode.title: Wire connection code description

descrWireGauge.definition: The element <descrWireGauge> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the wire gauge element <wireGauge>. Refer to Para 2.1.
descrWireGauge.title: Wire gauge description

descrWireInfoCircuitIdent.definition: The element <descrWireInfoCircuitIdent> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the circuit code element <circuitIdent> under element <wireInfo>. Refer to Para 2.1.
descrWireInfoCircuitIdent.title: Wire information circuit code description

descrWireInfoSectionIdent.definition: The element <descrWireInfoSectionIdent> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the wire section identification element <sectionIdent> under element <wireInfo>. Refer to Para 2.1.
descrWireInfoSectionIdent.title: Wire information section identification description

descrWireMaterial.definition: The element <descrWireMaterial> contains all relevant elements to describe the conduit data elements of the project.
descrWireMaterial.title: Wire material data/field descriptions

descrWireNumber.definition: The element <descrWireNumber> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the wire number element <wireNumber>. Refer to Para 2.1.
descrWireNumber.title: Wire number description

descrWireRoute.definition: The element <descrWireRoute> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the wire route lane code element <wireRoute>. Refer to Para 2.1.
descrWireRoute.title: Wire route lane code description

descrWireSeqNumber.definition: The element <descrWireSeqNumber> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the wire sequential number element <wireSeqNumber>. Refer to Para 2.1.
descrWireSeqNumber.title: Wire sequential number description

descrWireType.definition: The element <descrWireType> contains child elements, which provide a project or an organization specific name, a brief description and a reference to other data modules or publications for the wire type element <wireType>. Refer to Para 2.1.
descrWireType.title: Wire type description

detailedFaultDescr.definition: The element <detailedFaultDescr> contains the detailed description of the isolated fault.
detailedFaultDescr.title: Detailed description of the isolated fault

detectedFault.definition: The element <detectedFault> contains information on detected faults.
detectedFault.title: Detected faults

detectedLruItem.definition: The element <detectedLruItem> contains the identification, name and abbreviation of the detected LRU.
detectedLruItem.title: Detected Line Replaceable Unit (LRU) item

detectedSruItem.definition: The element <detectedSruItem> contains the identification, name and abbreviation of the detected SRU.
detectedSruItem.title: Detected Shop Replaceable Unit (SRU) item

detectionInfo.definition: The element <detectionInfo> contains the information for detecting the fault.
detectionInfo.title: Fault detecting information

diagnosticProcess.definition: The element <diagnosticProcess> contains a textual description of the reason and a reference to a repair procedure or any locating and repairing tasks and information on the faulty LRU.
diagnosticProcess.title: Diagnostics

dialog.definition: The element <dialog> allows the logic engine to interact with the user. It provides a means to obtain variable values from the user by asking him a question. Refer to Para 2.3.5 for expanded coverage of this element.
dialog.title: Dialog

dialogAlt.definition: The element <dialogAlt> groups configuration or situation unique dialogs for display to the user. Only one or none will be displayed depending on the applicability assigned to each element <dialog> within the element <dialogAlt>. Refer to Para 2.3.4.2.
dialogAlt.title: Dialog alternate

dialogGroup.definition: The element <dialogGroup> allows the positioning of multiple dialog elements in within one dialog either vertically or horizontally.
dialogGroup.title: Dialog layout

dispatchAddress.definition: The address from where the comment/response is sent.
dispatchAddress.title: Dispatch address

dispatchPerson.definition: As applicable, the element contains information about the dispatch person who is the point of contact at the sending enterprise.
dispatchPerson.title: Dispatch person

displayName.definition: The element <displayName> is used to define text which can be used to help automated generation the human readable display text on an applicability annotation (see Chap 7.8).
displayName.title: Display name

displayText.definition: The optional element <displayText> provides a human readable and printable branch of the applicability annotation. For those projects that do not require computable applicability, the display text is the only part of the applicability annotation needed. For annotations, the repeatable simple paragraph element <simplePara> can be used. Refer to Chap 7.8 for the recommended format for the content of element <displayText>.
displayText.title: Human readable applicability annotation branch

distributionPart.definition: The element <distributionPart> is contained in the list of distribution parts element <distributionPartGroup>. The list of distribution parts is a child element of the list of the standard parts element <standardPartGroup>.
distributionPart.title: Element <distributionPart> and child elements

dmAddress.definition: The element <dmAddress> is used to contain the unique identification and additional information supporting the data module.
dmAddress.title: Identification part

dmAddressItems.definition: The element <dmAddressItems> contains information that is supplementary to the data module identification but not part of the unique identifier.
dmAddressItems.title: Date module address items

dmCode.definition: The element <dmCode> contains the data module code and forms part of the unique identifier of a data module. All data modules are allocated a data module code.
dmCode.title: Data module code

dmEntry.definition: The data module entry gives the information items concerning a data module included in the data module requirement list.
dmEntry.title: Data module entry

dmIdent.definition: The element <dmIdent> is used to contain the unique identification of the data module.
dmIdent.title: Data module identification

dmIf.definition: A branch sends the user down separate data paths based on state information such as configuration information or how the user has answered questions. Branches can be nested.
dmIf.title: Data module branch

dmlAddress.definition: The identification consists of two blocks of information items used to uniquely address the data module requirement list object.
dmlAddress.title: Identification and status section

dmlCode.definition: Each data module requirement list is assigned a data module list code. Together with issue information it gives an identification that is unique within the S1000D domain.
dmlCode.title: Data module requirements list identification code

dmlContent.definition: The data module requirement list content is made up of a list of data module entries.
dmlContent.title: Data module requirements list content

dmLoop.definition: A loop repeats a sequence of information as long as the loop condition (based on state information) is true.
dmLoop.title: Data module loops

dmlRef.definition: In a data module requirement list, references can be made to other data module requirement lists (eg for partial data module requirement list). The references can be given by using the element <dmlCode> within the element <dmlRef>.
dmlRef.title: Reference

dmlRefGroup.definition: This element contains one or several references to data module lists to which the comment/response relates.
dmlRefGroup.title: Data module list reference group

dmlStatus.definition: The status section provides information about the status of the list.
dmlStatus.title: Data module requirements list status

dmNode.definition: A data module node represents technical information that is to be displayed on one screen. This screen can be scrollable.
dmNode.title: Data module node

dmNodeAlt.definition: An alternative (or conditional) node is a group of objects one or none of which will be applicable and thus displayed in a given situation.
dmNodeAlt.title: Alternative data module node

dmRef.definition: The element <dmRef> contains details of the destination data module that is referred from some other S1000D context, such as a data module, a publication module etc.
dmRef.title: References to data modules

dmRefAddressItems.definition: The element <dmRefAddressItems> contains additional identifying information about the destination data module.
dmRefAddressItems.title: Complementary identifying information for a data module

dmRefGroup.definition: This element contains one or several references to data modules to which the comment/response relates.
dmRefGroup.title: Data module reference group

dmRefIdent.definition: The element <dmRefIdent> contains the items forming a unique identification of the destination data module.
dmRefIdent.title: Identification of a referred data module

dmSeq.definition: A data module sequence determines the order of steps, dialogs, external application calls, data module references, and/or conditional actions within the data module.
dmSeq.title: Data module sequences

dmStatus.definition: The element <dmStatus> contains information about the status of the data module.
dmStatus.title: Status part

dmTitle.definition: The element <dmTitle> contains the title of the data module. The data module title must give meaning to the Product identification and action elements of the data module code. Authoring of titles must be in accordance with Chap 3.9.5.2.1.5.
dmTitle.title: Data module title

documentIncorporation.definition: The element <documentIncorporation> is used to list the data modules and publications that this technical condition affects.
documentIncorporation.title: Document incorporation

effectivity.definition: The element <effectivity> is used to identify a range of units or engines to which the item is fitted in this location.
effectivity.title: Effectivity

electricalEquip.definition: The element <electricalEquip> is contained within the list of electrical equipment element <electricalEquipGroup>. It contains electrical equipment information of the Product's wiring.
electricalEquip.title: Element <electricalEquip> and child elements

electricalEquipConnection.definition: The electrical equipment connection element <electricalEquipConnection> gives information about the electrical connections that belong to a transverse link.
electricalEquipConnection.title: Electrical equipment connections

electricalEquipState.definition: The electrical equipment state element <electricalEquipState> provides state information for each connection to some particular electrical equipment.
electricalEquipState.title: Electrical equipment state

electricalLogic.definition: The electrical logic element <electricalLogic> provides an optional container for electrical states and internal connections between contacts for electrical or electronic equipment.
electricalLogic.title: Electrical logic

electricalPotential.definition: The electrical potential element <electricalPotential> is used to order the wires based on project or organization specific rules, using the relation to termination module, block and shunt or pole and position, and the contact identification.
electricalPotential.title: Electrical potential

electricalStateDescr.definition: The electrical state description element <electricalStateDescr> contains the narrative description of an electrical state, eg “ENERGIZED".
electricalStateDescr.title: Electrical state description

elseIf.definition: The element <elseIf> is used to identify an "if" statement to be used if another "if" condition is not met.
elseIf.title: Else-if statement

email.definition: The element <email> is repeatable and contains contact fax numbers for the business.
email.title: Email addresses

emphasis.definition: The element <emphasis> contains eg a word, an expressions or a sentence to be highlighted.
emphasis.title: Emphasis

enabledState.definition: The element <enabledState> contains an expression that evaluates state variables to determine if data entry field input is permitted or inhibited (usually the data entry is visible, but dimmed or grayed out).
enabledState.title: User enabling/disabling entry

endMatter.definition: The element <endMatter> is used to contain end matter using the element <para>.
endMatter.title: End matter statement

enterprise.definition: The name of the enterprise, and when applicable body within an enterprise, from where the comment/response is sent.
enterprise.title: Enterprise

enterpriseIdent.definition: The element <enterpriseIdent> identifies the enterprise, through its CAGE code.
enterpriseIdent.title: Enterprise identification

enterpriseIdentAlt.definition: The element <enterpriseIdentAlt> provides an alternate method of identifying an enterprise where the enterprise doesn’t have a CAGE code.
enterpriseIdentAlt.title: Alternate enterprise identification

enterpriseName.definition: The responsible partner company name element <enterpriseName> gives the name of the company or the organization, which is responsible for the data.
enterpriseName.title: Responsible partner company name

enterpriseRef.definition: The element <enterpriseRef> is repeatable provides a method to refer other enterprises.
enterpriseRef.title: Enterprise references

enterpriseRepository.definition: The element <enterpriseRepository> contains a list of one or more element enterprise descriptions
enterpriseRepository.title: Enterprise list

enterpriseSpec.definition: The element <enterpriseSpec> contains the unique enterprise information for any enterprise that is involved in the development or supply of the product. It contains information about the enterprise such as manufacturer code, enterprise name, and business unit.
enterpriseSpec.title: Enterprise specification

entry.definition: The element <entry> (table entry) represents a table cell.
entry.title: Table entry

enumeration.definition: The element <enumeration> provides the allowable values for the product attribute. The allowable values can be used to assist the technical author in creating applicability annotations.
enumeration.title: Enumeration

equip.definition: The element <equip> provides a means to identify an individual piece of equipment associated with the task.
equip.title: Equipment

equipDescrRef.definition: The equipment description reference element <equipDescrRef> contains references to other parts of the electrical system publications, which give further information about this equipment, such as the description of how it is made.
equipDescrRef.title: Equipment description reference

equipGroup.definition: The element <equipGroup> provides a means to identify the equipments associated with the task.
equipGroup.title: Equipment group

equipName.definition: The electrical equipment name element <equipName> describes the equipment. A standard name like SWITCH can be used or a name that defines the equipment in conjunction with its use on the system, eg BATTERY MASTER SWITCH.
equipName.title: Electrical equipment name

equipNotAvailable.definition: The element <equipNotAvailable> defines the condition of the equipment (shortages, malfunctions, etc.) that will make equipment not ready or not available for use. This element is aligned with the checklist item or paragraph for which the equipment not ready/available is applicable. This element includes a required element <para>.
equipNotAvailable.title: Equipment not available

estimatedTime.definition: The element <estimatedTime> contains the estimate of the time that the person will be required on the task. The time must be given in hours with one decimal, eg 2,4 h, or days, eg 1,5 d. The time and unit of measurement must be entered.
estimatedTime.title: Estimated time

evaluate.definition: The element <evaluate> is used to group tests together and provide the logical operation to apply to the test results. The element <evaluate> must be used whenever more than one test, element <assert>, is required. The element <evaluate> can contain other element <evaluate> and is therefore recursive. This allows for very complicated applicability annotations to be represented with a simple structure consisting of only two element types.
evaluate.title: Grouping applicability tests - evaluate

excludedModification.definition: The element <excludedModification> contains an indication that the modification is not covered even though it was actually required.
excludedModification.title: Excluded modification

exportControl.definition: This element is used to define any government regulations concerning access to the data module.
exportControl.title: Export control

exportRegistrationCode.definition: This element is used to indicate a coded value representing an export control property that applies to the content of the data module.
exportRegistrationCode.title: Export registration code

exportRegistrationStmt.definition: This element is used to specify either a full or partial export control statement describing the export status of the data module content.
exportRegistrationStmt.title: Export statement

expression.definition: Expressions are combinations of variables and operators. The logic engine evaluates expressions primarily in order to determine what is displayed to the user as in applicability ([Model = "T"]) and branching ([If Error Condition = "4"]) and loop (WHILE [Counter < "5" ]) conditions. Expressions are also used to assign a value to a variable ([Ave = Sum / 3]). Refer to Chap 7.6.1 entitled "Expression evaluation" for detailed information.
expression.title: Expressions

externalApplication.definition: The element <externalApplication> is a mechanism for launching an external application in the midst of a process data module. This application might be a wiring data viewer, a calculator, a diagnostic test, etc. Refer to Para 2.3.8 for expanded coverage of this element.
externalApplication.title: External application

externalPubCode.definition: The element <externalPubCode> contains, as text content, a code that identifies a non S1000D document, such as an ISBN code or similar.
externalPubCode.title: Identifying code of an external document

externalPubIssue.definition: The element <externalPubIssue> contains, as text content, issue designation of a non S1000D document.
externalPubIssue.title: Issue information of an external document

externalPubIssueInfo.definition: The element <externalPubIssueInfo> contains issue information concerning e referred non S1000D document.
externalPubIssueInfo.title: Issue information of an external document

externalPubRef.definition: The element <externalPubRef> contains the identification of a referenced non S10000D publication or document.
externalPubRef.title: References to external documents

externalPubRefAddressItems.definition: The element <externalPubRefAddressItems> contains, as text content, additional information potentially useful to identify the external destination publication or document.
externalPubRefAddressItems.title: Complementary identifying information for an external document

externalPubRefIdent.definition: The element <externalPubRefIdent> contains the identification of the non S1000D publication or document.
externalPubRefIdent.title: Identification of an external document

externalPubTitle.definition: The element <externalPubTitle> contains, as text content, a code that identifies a non S1000D document, such as an ISBN code or similar.
externalPubTitle.title: Title of an external document

externalSco.definition: The element <externalSco> is used to identify any external SCOs, which are required within the current SCO. The elements <title> and <filename>, which identifies the file for the external SCO, are required. The use of <externalSco > should be explained in the business rules.
externalSco.title: External SCO references

extraResources.definition: The element <extraResources> is used to references all figures and multimedia required to appear in the SCO. The elements <figure> and <multimedia> can be used, as required.
extraResources.title: Extra SCO resources

fastener.definition: This element is used to store access point fastener information.
fastener.title: Fastener

fastenerQuantity.definition: This element is used to indicate the quantity of fasteners.
fastenerQuantity.title: Fastener quantity

fastenerType.definition: This element is used to indicate the type of the fastener.
fastenerType.title: Fastener type

faultDescr.definition: The element <faultDescr> contains the description of the isolated fault.
faultDescr.title: Description of the isolated fault

faultIsolation.definition: The fault isolation branch of the Schema identifies and describes the fault and gives the diagnostic path to isolate a faulty item.
faultIsolation.title: Fault isolation

faultIsolationProcedure.definition: The element <faultIsolationProcedure> contains the detailed fault isolation procedure including fault code, fault description.
faultIsolationProcedure.title: Fault isolation procedure

faultIsolationTest.definition: The element <faultIsolationTest > contains the test description, test parameters and the test procedure.
faultIsolationTest.title: Fault isolation test performance

faultReporting.definition: The element <faultReporting > contains information to enable technician or computerized maintenance systems to indicate faults through data modules.
faultReporting.title: Fault reporting

faxNumber.definition: The element <faxNumber> is repeatable and contains contact fax numbers for the business.
faxNumber.title: FAX numbers

feedThru.definition: If a wire passes through equipment, eg a current transformer, this is identified by using the feed-through element <feedThru>.
feedThru.title: Feed-through information

fieldName.definition: The data/field name element <fieldName> contains the name of the data field, ie the project or the organization specific naming of electrical data.
fieldName.title: Data/field name

figure.definition: This element contains the figure. The figure consists of a title and one or more illustrations sheets and a figure title. It can also contain a legend.
figure.title: General

finishingInfo.definition: The element <finishingInfo> contains the finishing information for the connection of wires to a contact. Refer to Chap 3.9.5.2.9.2.
finishingInfo.title: Finishing information

firstName.definition: The element <firstName> contains the first name of the individual contact.
firstName.title: First name

firstVerification.definition: The element <firstVerification> contains identifies a data module which has been first verified. For details on verification, refer to Chap 3.7.
firstVerification.title: First verification

fitmentCode.definition: The element <fitmentCode> is used to indicate whether an item can be fitted as supplied.
fitmentCode.title: Fitment code

foldout.definition: The element <foldout> is used to contain a figure, or table which is larger than the default size.
foldout.title: Foldouts

footnote.definition: The element <footnote> contains can eg bibliographic references or explanations which would take too much space or in any other way would be annoying for the reader.
footnote.title: Footnote

footnoteRef.definition: The element <footnoteRef> contains the link to a previously defined footnote. The same link is used to reference the same footnote many times.
footnoteRef.title: Footnote reference

frequency.definition: The element <frequency> contains the frequency of wire material in relation to the attenuation.
frequency.title: Frequency

frequencyAttenuation.definition: The element <frequencyAttenuation> is a repeatable container for frequency and attenuation information of wire material.
frequencyAttenuation.title: Frequency and attenuation

frequencyCharacteristics.definition: The element <frequencyCharacteristics> contains alternating current (AC) frequency characteristics of wire material.
frequencyCharacteristics.title: Frequency characteristics

fromEquip.definition: The content model electrical equipment defines the child elements of elements <fromEquip> and <toEquip>, which contain the wire connection information for the two wire ends.
fromEquip.title: Content model electrical equipment

functionalDescrRef.definition: The functional description reference element <functionalDescrRef> contains references to other parts of the electrical system publications for further information about a wire, eg a description of how it is made and its function. References must be populated in accordance with Chap 3.9.5.2.1.2.
functionalDescrRef.title: Functional description reference

functionalItemAlt.definition: This element contains the properties of the functional item that depend on the Product configuration. Thus this element contains applicability.
functionalItemAlt.title: Alternate functional item

functionalItemCode.definition: The element <functionalItemCode> can contain a code that represents the functional breakdown.
functionalItemCode.title: Functional item code

functionalItemIdent.definition: Contrary to the attribute id, this element identifies semantically the functional item as a result of its attributes. The codification of functional item identifier is up to the project or the organization.
functionalItemIdent.title: Functional item identifier

functionalItemRef.definition: The element <functionalItemRef> contains a functional item number.
functionalItemRef.title: Functional item reference

functionalItemRefGroup.definition: The element <functionalItemRef> contains a functional item number.
functionalItemRefGroup.title: Functional item reference

functionalItemRepository.definition: This element is used to provide a list of functional items and their associated properties.
functionalItemRepository.title: General

functionalItemSpec.definition: This element represents one functional item. It contains its associated properties.
functionalItemSpec.title: Functional item specification

functionalPhysicalAreaIdent.definition: Contrary to the attribute id, the element <functionalPhysicalAreaIdent> identifies semantically the functional and/or physical area as a result of its attributes. In addition to the functional and/or physical area identifier, the system difference code can be specified for each functional and/or physical area.
functionalPhysicalAreaIdent.title: Functional and/or physical area identifier

functionalPhysicalAreaRef.definition: The element <functionalPhysicalAreaRef> is used to markup a functional and/or physical area (outside of its specification in the functional and/or physical area technical repository) and also allows referring to its specification in the functional and/or physical area technical repository.
functionalPhysicalAreaRef.title: Functional and/or physical area

functionalPhysicalAreaRefGroup.definition: The element <functionalPhysicalAreaRefGroup> allows reflecting the functional and/or physical breakdown. If used, it must only contain the links from a functional and/or physical area to its direct children.
functionalPhysicalAreaRefGroup.title: References to other functional and/or physical areas

functionalPhysicalAreaRepository.definition: The element <functionalPhysicalAreaRepository> is used to provide a list of functional and/or physical areas and their associated properties.
functionalPhysicalAreaRepository.title: General

functionalPhysicalAreaSpec.definition: This element represents one functional and/or physical area and its properties.
functionalPhysicalAreaSpec.title: Functional and/or physical area specification

genericPartData.definition: The element <genericPartData> is used to identify the specific version of the equipment to which the item is fitted in this location.
genericPartData.title: Generic Part data

genericPartDataGroup.definition: The element <genericPartDataGroup> is used to store any program specific data.
genericPartDataGroup.title: Non S2000M data

genericPartDataValue.definition: The element <genericPartDataValue> is used to store the non S2000M element value.
genericPartDataValue.title: Generic Part data value

graphic.definition: This element contains the external entity reference to the illustration file.
graphic.title: Graphic

groupCode.definition: The group code element <groupCode> indicates the physical grouping of wires connected to the same contact. For example, where multiple wires are connected to a terminal stud using multiple ring terminals, each wire connected to the same ring terminal must have the same group code, eg A. Wires that are connected to the same terminal stud but to another ring terminal must have another group code, eg B. This means that an identical group code indicates wires, which are physically connected to the same ring terminal.
groupCode.title: Group code

groupNumber.definition: The element <groupNumber> is used to capture the functional item group of the end item. The functional group applies to repairable assemblies and subassemblies, ie spares (any repairable component required for the maintenance or repair of an end item), but not to repair parts (any consumable, non-repairable component required for the maintenance or repair of an end item).
groupNumber.title: Maintenance allocation group number

harness.definition: The element <harness> is contained within the list of harnesses element <harnessGroup>. It contains harness information of the Product's wiring. The electrical wires of a system are often divided into separate harnesses.
harness.title: Element <harness> and child elements

harnessEnvironment.definition: The element <harnessEnvironment> gives information concerning the environment in which a harness is located.
harnessEnvironment.title: Harness environment

harnessIdent.definition: The harness identification is the unique identifier of a harness in the system. It is the link between the harness and the included wires.
harnessIdent.title: Harness identification

harnessInfo.definition: The element <harnessInfo> contains harness information for the detailed identification of a harness, eg the part number and alternative identifications that can be used to identify this harness.
harnessInfo.title: Harness information

harnessName.definition: The harness name element <harnessName> gives the name of a harness.
harnessName.title: Harness name

harnessSize.definition: The element <harnessSize> describes the minimum and the maximum size of the harness, to which a shrink sleeve can be applied.
harnessSize.title: Harness size

harnessVariantIdent.definition: The harness variant identification element <harnessVariantIdent> contains the variant of a harness. Improvements during series production or engineering requirements are reasons why different harnesses are used in one type of system. This element identifies the different harnesses. A harness variant can be part of the project or the organization specific part number.
harnessVariantIdent.title: Harness variant
